messages:
mira: Quick design review for the on-prem preflight step. I reworked the layout so the probe summary sits above the fold as a single-line compact card, with a collapsible details panel and a "Download logs" affordance. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/mnop3456/onprem-preflight-v2 Can folks look at motion/announce behavior, microcopy for CTAs, and the visual priority of error vs warning states? jamal: Looks nice. Concern: when the details panel expands it pushes other steps down and keyboard users lose context. Also the animated status chip (pulse -> error) causes a focus reflow. Recommend reserving space for expanded content with max-height transitions to reduce layout shift. sophia: Accessibility notes: prefer aria-live="polite" for passive updates but use assertive for critical failure that requires immediate attention. Don't auto-focus expanded content unless the user explicitly triggers it. For screen readers the collapsed card should include a concise aria-label like "Network check: 3 probes, 1 failed". alex: Implementation: keep the card in DOM and toggle an attribute (data-expanded) instead of removing nodes. Use CSS transforms and opacity for animation; avoid height animations that repaint heavy layouts. Add a visually-hidden sr-only summary element for each probe with a stable id so automated tests can query results. marc: Copy suggestions: change primary CTA from "Run probes" -> "Start network check". Change secondary "View details" -> "Open probe logs". For failures replace "Check your firewall" with "Verify firewall rules allow outbound traffic to these ports:" and include the ports inline. Also shorten error header to "Network check failed". riley: UX idea: add a small toggle "Show verbose logs" that persists across sessions. Default to collapsed for most users. Keyboard flow: if a user tabs into the card and presses enter on the card header it should expand and focus the first interactive element inside (e.g., Retry). That must be predictable and reversible via escape key. jamal: Minimal aria snippet for the card header: ```html
Network check 3 probes
``` When expanded set aria-expanded=true and move focus to a focusable child if the expansion was triggered by keyboard. sophia: Contrast: the warning (amber) chip on light background fails AA for small text. Either darken the amber, increase font weight, or switch to an icon+text pattern with a darker label. Also ensure focus outline is visible on the chip and primary CTA. alex: On error messaging: when upstream returns 504 show a succinct suggestion "Gateway timed out try increasing the probe timeout or switch to the dedicated region" and provide a one-click quick-probe that runs fewer checks. I'll add this mapping to the probe error handler. marc: For microcopy: change ephemeral copy "Try again later" to actionable steps: "1) Open probe logs 2) Confirm egress IPs 3) Contact infra if needed". Users respond better to step-by-step items. jamal: CSS note: use prefers-reduced-motion to disable the pulse animation and replace with a static icon change. Also use min-width on the chip to prevent width jumps during state changes. I'll push a small patch. deploy-bot: preview build for branch preflight-v2 is live: https://preview.redwood.com/branches/preflight-v2 includes collapsed card, stable DOM toggles, and aria labels. Please smoke test keyboard + VO. mira: I'll update Figma copy with Marc's action list and Riley's toggle. Sophia, can you run a VoiceOver + keyboard pass Wednesday? Jamal, add prefers-reduced-motion support and the min-width fix. Alex, please wire the 504 -> quick-probe fallback. sophia: Yes. I'll check keyboard expand/escape behavior, aria-expanded toggles, aria-controls mapping, sr-only summaries, and chip contrast. I'll report any regressions in this thread. mira: Thanks team :thumbsup: Action items captured. Closing thread unless new regressions reported.
